# Andrey Zakharov / Андрей Захаров

Personal bilingual website of a software engineer. The linked pages contain the public, human-readable source information. English and Russian versions have separate URLs.

## English

- [About Andrey Zakharov](https://theandreyzakharov.com/): professional background, experience, learning, research interests and collaboration.
- [Projects and experience](https://theandreyzakharov.com/projects/): project descriptions, roles, technologies, work and repository links.
- [Resumes](https://theandreyzakharov.com/resumes/): role-specific resumes and PDF downloads.
- [Education](https://theandreyzakharov.com/education/): degrees, retraining and professional development.
- [Diplomas and certificates](https://theandreyzakharov.com/certificates/): searchable document archive.
- [Publications](https://theandreyzakharov.com/publications/): articles and bibliographic details.
- [Implementing AI Tools in Management Processes](https://theandreyzakharov.com/publications/ai-tools-in-management-processes/): conference paper and publication details.
- [Patents](https://theandreyzakharov.com/patents/): patent records section.
- [Socials and contact](https://theandreyzakharov.com/socials/): official profiles and ways to reach Andrey.

## Русский

- [Обо мне](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/): профессиональный профиль, опыт, обучение, научные интересы и сотрудничество.
- [Проекты и опыт](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/projects/): описания проектов, роли, технологии, выполненная работа и ссылки на репозитории.
- [Резюме](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/resumes/): резюме для разных ролей и PDF-файлы.
- [Образование](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/education/): высшее и дополнительное образование.
- [Дипломы и сертификаты](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/certificates/): архив документов с поиском.
- [Публикации](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/publications/): статьи и библиографические сведения.
- [Внедрение ИИ-инструментов в управленческие процессы](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/publications/ai-tools-in-management-processes/): статья и сведения о публикации.
- [Патенты](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/patents/): раздел патентных записей.
- [Соцсети и контакты](https://theandreyzakharov.com/ru/socials/): официальные профили и способы связи.
